title: Lifecycle state machine: illegal transitions, edit locks, obsolescence, undo/replay safety, tamper detection

expect.summaryMatches: release_item rejected: LL-2001 rev A is in_work; submit_for_review first

cases.given: LL-2001 rev A in_review; policy.requireIndependentChecker = true

expect.summaryMatches: checker must differ from the author
rejected: LL-2001 rev A is released; open an ECO and revise_item

expect.note: view state is outside the release scope (selection, camera) and stays editable

expect.summaryMatches: revise_item rejected: a released revision can only be revised under an open change order (policy.requireChangeOrder)

cases.given: LL-2001 rev A released, rev B released (A superseded)

expect.summaryMatches: superseded -> in_work is not an allowed transition

cases.given: rev A released at document step k; user presses Undo in the UI

expect.note: Undo of release_item is refused by the store when the release has been persisted to the vault (release is an irreversible business event); before persistence it is allowed and emits audit 'release_reverted'.

cases.given: rev A released with contentHash H; a file editor changes parameters.t.expression in the saved .llull.json outside llull
rev A released; replay of featureHistory (regenerate) after kernel upgrade

expect.data.geometryFingerprintMatches: true or reported drift with per-entity volume/bbox deltas (tolerance 1e-6 relative)

expect.summaryMatches: record_signature rejected: signature does not verify
